notes: On the page, each price and its '/month' label are on separate lines. For example, '$250' is on line 167 and '/month' is on line 168. I combined them, and each line number given is the line with the price. The bundled prices are chat add-ons that are charged on top of whichever virtual receptionist plan you choose. The page says each one is 'a 20% savings' (lines 92, 99 and 107), and line 288 says you can save 20% on chat by adding it to a receptionist plan. The page does not say how often the bundled add-on is billed. The page does not state any overage rates. It says larger plans are available if you contact sales (lines 133, 215 and 286). It says optional AI enhancements are included in all plans at no extra cost (lines 217-218). All of the plan cards appear twice in the snapshot.

setup_fee.text: There are no additional or hidden fees for activation, onboarding, setup, customization, or coverage during certain periods.
